detail_text: PART NUMBERS & REQUIRED SUPPLIES: MP-3512/TG - 30-512MHz Manpack Antenna - Gooseneck 1Y58950 - MPDP225X2/1.25-2.7, 225-450 and 1250-2700 MHz 12500-2500-02 - BATTERY PK, RECHARGEABLE, 7.0A-HR LITH ION, GRN E45-0070-414 - O-RING EPDM, 70 DURO, 2.5MM W, 14MM ID BT-70791CK - BATTERY, LiION, BB-2590,251Wh Any questions regarding this Request for Information Notice shall be submitted in writing via email to Contract Specialist, Katelyn Timmermann, at katelyn.timmermann@us.af.mil and Contracting Officer, Angela Port, at angela.port@us.af.mil. Verbal questions will not be accepted. The Government does not guarantee that questions receive after 29 April 2026 will be answered. Businesses who wish to respond to this should send responses via email no later than 01 May 2026 at 12 PM Central Standard Time (CST) to the Contract Specialist, Katelyn Timmermann, at katelyn.timmermann@us.af.mil and Contracting Officer, Angela Port, at angela.port@us.af.mil.
